title: Best AI study apps for exams, and Quizlet alternatives
summary: Choose by the kind of answer you need to produce.
body_markdown:
Choose by the kind of answer you need to produce. Quizlet fits a student who already has a good set of terms. Knowt fits someone who wants free practice tests and spaced repetition. For an exam graded on explanations, include a written answer in your trial.


Educato publishes this page and makes one of the apps on it. We list it where it fits, with its limits.

## Which is the best study app for exams with AI if I already use Quizlet?


Choose Knowt to reuse a flashcard deck, ChatGPT to work through a missed question step by step, or Educato to practice answering questions from your course files. Take a question you missed on a past assignment. Cover the choices and explain what would make the right answer true. If you can select the right option but cannot finish that sentence, look for a way to practice explanations. Another deck of nearly identical questions may just teach you to recognize the wording.


### A statistics midterm with two different kinds of questions


Suppose your instructor hands back a quiz about a school survey. On the first question you correctly identified a voluntary response sample. On the second you lost points for saying, “They needed more people.” Your deck already taught you the term. To earn the missing points, you need to explain who got counted and how that could change the conclusion.


Here is an original practice question. The student council wants to know what share of all students would attend a Friday concert. It posts a poll on the music club's message board. Of 200 respondents, 160 say yes. A council member predicts that 80 percent of the school will attend. What can the council reasonably infer from the poll?


A weak answer is “The poll is biased because only 200 students answered.” That leaves the impression that collecting another 200 replies on the same board would solve the problem. A stronger answer is “Eighty percent of respondents said yes. Students who read the music board and chose to reply may be more interested in the concert than other students. We cannot extend that percentage to the whole school from this poll.” Notice that the last answer gives the 160 replies their due. They tell us something quite specific.


Give yourself a point for naming the group behind the percentage and another for explaining how recruitment could affect the estimate. As a follow-up, imagine that every student receives the poll by email but responding is optional. Which part of your explanation survives? Everyone now gets an invitation. Students with strong opinions can still be more likely to reply. Getting that distinction onto paper is a better rehearsal for a written midterm than seeing how quickly you can flip a card.


### Quizlet


Quizlet offers flashcards and practice questions on a free account. Compare the limits on Learn and practice tests for Plus with the unlimited tier before buying. If your main task is retrieving definitions once before a quiz, the extra modes may go unused.[Read the product details](https://quizlet.com/upgrade?source=signup) .


If your class shares a reliable Quizlet set, keep the instructor's vocabulary and add a case to the front of a troublesome card. “What is voluntary response?” can be answered from memory word for word. “Who decided which invited students ended up in the email survey?” makes you identify the mechanism. Try the free flashcards with those revisions before counting how many Learn rounds you expect to use.


### Knowt


Knowt fits a learner carrying a set of cards over from another tool. Import or create the cards, then try retrieving the answer in free Learn Mode or a practice test. Ultra adds summaries and podcasts if reading the original sources is the bottleneck.[Read the product details](https://knowt.com/plans?tab=Student+Ultra) .


Knowt makes sense when you have several chapters of terms and want to return to them across the week. Import a small set first. Read both sides of a card containing a percentage, then check that the group it describes is still clear. If the set is ready to study, free practice tests and spaced repetition address that job without an Ultra subscription. Summarizing the original lecture is a separate reason to consider Ultra.


### ChatGPT


ChatGPT study mode works through uploaded notes and PDFs and can ask follow-up questions on free or paid plans. Bring the sentence from the source that makes your answer defensible. Then ask for a changed example and answer it before reading feedback.[Read the product details](https://help.openai.com/en/articles/11780217-chatgpt-study-mode-faq) .


For the concert problem, try a specific instruction in Study mode. “Ask me what the council can conclude. Wait for my answer. Then challenge one assumption I made without giving away the solution.” When you finish, compare your explanation with the instructor's marking notes. A tutor can keep the conversation going after a partial answer. On the exam you must spot the missing step without that follow-up, so write the answer again on a blank page.


### Educato


Best for students who want to turn lecture files into practice and revisit the concepts with flashcards. Limits: the free account does not give full access. Try a troublesome course document before paying for a broader study routine.


Imagine that the sampling definitions are in a slide deck but the instructor drew the invitation and response groups on the board. In Educato you can study from the slides and a photo of that drawing. AI-graded open answers give you a way to rehearse the two-sentence inference. Keep the instructor's scoring criteria beside your answer when reviewing feedback, especially if a course awards separate points for the calculation and the interpretation.


### Quizlet alternatives for exam prep?


Knowt is a close alternative if you already like studying with cards and want free practice tests. Study mode in ChatGPT is a different choice for working through the reasoning behind a missed answer. Decide whether you want to move a deck or change how you practice before comparing subscription tiers.


### best app for test prep with practice questions?


Bring a question from a graded assignment to the decision. If the exam asks you to distinguish plausible choices, inspect the reasons the distractors are wrong. If it asks for a written justification, practice producing that justification before looking at choices. A large supply of prompts is only helpful when they exercise the right skill.


To compare two tools, reserve one unused question from the same assignment. Spend a study session on your original mistake, then attempt the reserved question the following day under the exam's usual conditions. Record what you could do unaided. If you calculated the percentage correctly both times but explained the sample only after a hint, use your next session for another short written inference. A fresh practice test is worth more once you can explain why the tempting answer fails.
